name: Delta AC Wallbox
description: The `delta_wallbox` component connects to a Delta AC wallbox over Bluetooth Low Energy. It reports the charger's model, serial number, firmware versions, state, power, energy and charging time, lets you set the maximum charging current, and can start and stop a charging session.

config_entries.label: Password
config_entries.description: The password from the Delta app.

config_entries.label: Pin
config_entries.description: The six-digit pairing PIN from the Delta app, needed when the charger asks for a passkey while pairing.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often to read the charger. Defaults to `15s`.

config_entries.label: BLE Client ID
config_entries.description: The BLE client the charger is reached through.

config_entries.label: Time ID
config_entries.description: A [time](https://esphome.io/components/time/) source. When set, the charger's clock is synchronized at every connection so that its own logs carry the right time.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

config_entries.label: User
config_entries.description: The user name to log in with. Up to 6 characters. Defaults to `admin`.
